title: Shared S02 timing controller vs per-engine S02_MEM_IF placeholders
claim: Brief states S02 has one shared timing controller and S07-S09 have 3 S02_MEM_IF as page-in placeholders; REQ/WE/ACK/DONE/BUSY need verification.
evidence: grep S02_MEM_IF count: 206 occurrences across project (S07/S08/S09). No S02_MEM_IF found in S02_Timing.kicad_sch; S02_Timing uses 74HC138/74HC688 and MEM_nCE/nOE/nWE outputs.

S07_Conv1.kicad_sch shows S02_MEM_IF with REQ/WE in, MEM_nCE/nOE/nWE/ACK/DONE/BUSY out; internal labels C1_MEM_REQ/C1_MEM_nCE etc.; globals C1_MEM_nCE_MC/Q/B/OUT/W appear. Connection to S04/S02 not visible as single shared controller connection in simple grep (appears engine-local IF).
Root sheet text states 'Memory timing controller ... nCE/nOE/nWE active-low, ACK handshake' on S02 and lists MEM_nCE/nOE/nWE/MEM_ACK on root, while engines list C1/C2/FC_ADDR/MEM_nCE_*.
proposed_fix: Trace S07/S08/S09 S02_MEM_IF outputs to global nets and confirm they connect to actual S02 instance (or document bus fabric). If engine-local IFs generate mem controls independently, reconcile with 'one shared S02' claim and arbitration.

title: Engine memory interface reachability to S04/ADDR/MEM_SEL unclear
claim: Brief asks whether Cx_ADDR/Cx_MEM_nCE connect to S04 ADDR/MEM_SEL (if not, joint logic incomplete).
evidence: Connection matrix shows MEM_nCE/nOE/nWE from S02->S04 and ADDR/MEM_SEL from S10/S04 context; engines produce C1_MEM_nCE_*/C1_ADDR-like nets (globals appear in S07). Root sheet lists 'C1_DONE,C1_BUSY,C1_ADDR[15:0], C1_MEM_nCE_*' and similar for C2/FC.
No direct grep evidence of Cx_ADDR connected to top-level S04 ADDR/MEM_SEL bus in quick scan; requires netlist-level tracing. Cannot confirm with text grep alone.
proposed_fix: Export hierarchical netlist (kicad-cli) and trace each engine's memory request/address to S04; verify MEM_SEL decoding covers engine windows. Document in connection matrix.

title: 12x LUT_Mult_Unit vs 4 shared LUT lanes + 8x 27C512 in S04
claim: Brief states 12 LUT_Mult_Unit blocks may be logical view of 4 shared LUT lanes; S04 has 8x 27C512 as physical LUT tables.
evidence: LUT_Mult_Unit count: 543 occurrences across project. S07 shows 4x LUT_Mult_Unit (text: 'MAC datapath: 4x LUT_Mult_Unit...'), S08/S09 similar (4 each). S_LUT_Mult_1 is unit reference sheet. BOM lists 12x 'LUT_Mult_Unit' (U7057-U7060,U8061-U8064,U9046-U9049).
S04 has 17x 27C512 total in BOM (U1001,U1002,U2001,U4020-U4027,U7136,U7137,U8140,U8141,U9127,U9128). Sim confirms LUT contents/spice tests pass for generated LUTs.
proposed_fix: Clarify mapping: are LUT_Mult_Unit physical blocks or schematic symbols instantiating shared ROMs? Cross-reference to S04 ROM selection (MEM_SEL/LUT related) and ensure BOM count matches intended architecture.

title: 42 pin_not_driven errors at top level - classify internal vs external
claim: Top level still has 42 pin_not_driven errors; need to judge external interface vs true internal breaks.
evidence: Main ERC: CNN_74xx_System.rpt ends with 'ERC messages: 940 Errors 42 Warnings 898'. Sample shows pin_not_driven on U5012/U5013 pins (S02 area) and others. Docs state some are external inputs when viewed per-sheet; need hierarchical classification.
